findingDetails.title: CLI package test command and root multi-project test configuration are not one proven contract
findingDetails.evidence: The CLI package invokes ../vitest.config.ts while the root config defines a separate runtime/cli-rooted project and the runtime config excludes runtime/cli.
findingDetails.recommendation: Choose one authoritative CLI Vitest config and make the package and root gates invoke it explicitly.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the root package manifest, CLI manifest, root Vitest config and runtime Vitest config.

findingDetails.title: Moved package README retains stale scripts topology
findingDetails.evidence: The package is at runtime/cli, but the topology block begins with scripts/ and lists memory/.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rewrite the package topology block to use runtime/cli and continuity.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the moved package README and package manifest.
